label: Crème caramel
note: Egg custard baked in a bain-marie over a layer of caramel, then turned out so the caramel runs down; called flan in Spanish-speaking countries. First documented in its modern form in Reboul, La cuisinière provençale, 1897.

about.text: A baked egg custard set over a layer of soft caramel and turned out of its mould.
